tecnicas.observacao: Prompt de sistema comum (persona de engenheiro Python, objetivo de extrair método preservando a funcionalidade → instrucao; saída apenas em código executável, sem explicações → restricoes), código-alvo fornecido no prompt (contexto) e laço de realimentação com mensagens de falha dos testes (feedback). A primeira tentativa do RCI é zero-shot, sem exemplo (p. 6). O contraste executado é RCI × one-shot (Tabela II): as duas condições diferem em mais de um ingrediente (o RCI não tem o exemplo resolvido do one-shot e acrescenta o laço de feedback), de modo que o ganho é do pacote e não pode ser atribuído só ao feedback. O contraste com a tentativa zero-shot inicial (p. 6) é por rodada, dentro das mesmas execuções do RCI (contribuição cumulativa das rodadas de feedback), e não uma condição executada separadamente. Número máximo de tentativas descrito de forma inconsistente (ver heterogeneidade).

citacoes.trecho: In this work, we critically evaluate five state-of-the-art open-source LLMs, spanning 3B to 8B parameter sizes, on the EMR task for Python code.

We systematically assess functional correctness and code quality using automated metrics and investigate the impact of prompting strategies by comparing one-shot prompting to a Recursive criticism and improvement (RCI) approach.
You are an expert Python software engineer.
citacoes.localizador: Fig. 3, System Prompt, p. 4 do PDF

citacoes.trecho: Only output valid, executable Python code and do not provide any explanations or comments.
citacoes.localizador: Fig. 3, System Prompt, p. 4 do PDF

citacoes.trecho: One-Shot Prompting: A single EMR example is provided to guide the model's transformation, minimizing complexity and inference time.
If incorrect, targeted feedback based on test case errors is added to the prompt, and the model tries again.
By design, initial attempt of RCI is a zero-shot attempt, the model is given only the task specification and target code (no examples, no test-failure feedback).
Models were instructed to output only executable code, avoid explanations, and limit changes to the EMR.
TPP serves as the primary metric for comparing models and prompt strategies head-to-head.
We computed TPP for every model and both prompting strategies (one-shot and RCI) across all 840 code samples.
One-shot logs the failure, while the RCI appends test feedback to the conversation and retries, up to two attempts.
This process can repeat up to three times, simulating iterative improvement.
Candidates passing test cases are then analyzed using metrics like CC and LOC.
Importantly, even with this simple capped budget, RCI delivered >10 percentage point improvements in TPP, showing robustness across models.

We observed that most improvements occurred early: for instance, Qwen2.5-Coder and DeepSeek-Coder, successfully refactored about 64% and 67% of cases, respectively, in the first iteration, with a further 25% and 30% corrected after the second.

Zero-shot results were consistently lower than both one-shot and RCI conditions, TPP = 0.472 for CodeQwen-1.5, 0.686 for Qwen2.5-Coder, 0.706 for DeepSeek-Coder, 0.334 for Llama-3.2, and 0.427 for Phi-4.

Interestingly, Llama3.2-Oneshot and Phi-4-RCI report the lowest CC values (2.87 and 3.28), but as with LOC, these models also produce many incomplete or incorrect outputs, as indicated by their low TPP.
The best-performing approaches: Qwen2.5-Coder-RCI (5.58) and DeepSeek-Coder-RCI (6.19) achieve more than a 50% reduction in LOC compared to the original code.
This is due to incomplete or trivial code generations that may be short, but do not produce functionally correct solutions.
This detailed view shows that specific problems, such as p02684, p02685, and p02686, are complex for all models: even the highest-performing models fail to achieve a 50% pass rate on these tasks.
Gains were largest for high-performing models.
Across all models, RCI-based prompting consistently outperformed one-shot prompting, with average TPP improvements of 8–14 percentage points depending on the model.
RCI-based prompting consistently outperforms one-shot prompting in test pass rates and refactoring quality.
A developer survey on RCI-generated refactorings shows over 70% acceptance, with Qwen2.5-Coder rated highest across all evaluation criteria.
Prompting Strategies: Comparison of one-shot vs. RCI, showing RCI significantly boosts refactoring success.

citacoes.trecho: To assess the consistency of human judgments, we computed the quadratic-weighted Cohen's κ across all rater pairs, obtaining an average κ ≈ 0.30, with individual values ranging from 0.17 to 0.52 depending on the survey statement.
To keep the survey manageable and avoid participant fatigue, each developer reviewed 20 code samples covering five distinct problems.
For every sample, developers rated the original code and three RCI-refactored versions.
From the full set of Python problems (800), we filtered for those that: (a) have a CC of three and sufficient length for EMR.
While traditional metrics like CC and LOC provide useful signals, they often diverge from human judgments, emphasizing the need for human-in-the-loop evaluation.
The RCI prompting approach uses automated test failures as feedback for language models, but this may overlook nuanced or contextual guidance.

extracoes.benchmark: Subconjunto de Python do CodeNet (21 problemas, 840 amostras de código)
extracoes.metrica: EM TPP (Test Pass Percentage): proporção de refatorações que passam em todos os casos de teste originais
extracoes.denominador: 840 amostras de código por modelo e estratégia (texto, p. 5)
extracoes.condicoes: Mesmo prompt de sistema nas duas condições. One-shot: um exemplo de Extract Method no prompt, uma única tentativa. RCI: primeira tentativa zero-shot (sem exemplo) e novas tentativas com feedback das falhas de teste; número máximo de tentativas descrito de forma inconsistente (até duas tentativas, p. 3; até três vezes, p. 4; attempt < 3, Fig. 1). O ganho é do pacote RCI e não pode ser atribuído só ao feedback, pois o comparador tem exemplo e o RCI não. Parâmetros de decodificação, número de execuções e testes estatísticos: nao_informado. GPU única V100 16GB. Sem agregado impresso entre modelos; usado o primeiro modelo da Tabela II. Valores conferidos visualmente na Tabela II (p. 5 do PDF) e no texto da p. 5.
extracoes.selecao_motivo: Resumo e contribuições identificam uma técnica (RCI) contra um comparador (one-shot), e a seção de método declara TPP como métrica primária para comparar estratégias de prompt. Resultado abrange cinco modelos sem agregado impresso compatível; aplicado o primeiro modelo na ordem da Tabela II (CodeQwen-1.5).
